column1: # The boards this repository knows, and the MAC that identifies each. Read by
# tools/board-guard.sh so that one board's firmware cannot be written to
# another: lilly and wave are both ESP32-S3 with native USB and both appear as
# /dev/cu.usbmodem*, so the port alone says nothing about which is which.
# Add a board by running any flash script against it once; it prints the MAC it
# saw and how to record it.
